meta.method: GES DISC Giovanni in the Cloud Time Series Service (successor of the retired Hydrology Data Rods service); point time series, one request per point per chunk, cached under pipeline/cache/imerg_history
meta.note: satellite estimate; ~10 km cells smooth point intensities
notes: a day qualifies if any point daily total >= 50 mm or any 30-min intensity >= 30 mm/h
consecutive qualifying days are merged into one candidate
severity = max point total over the candidate; rank 1 is most severe
antecedent_7d_mean_mm: mean over the 7 days before the start of the across-point mean daily total
